title: Motor population co-smoothing
scientific_question: Can observed neurons predict withheld neurons during reaching without seeing those neurons at query time?
primary_outputs: Strictly positive finite expected spike counts per 5 ms bin for all 574 development trials × 140 bins × 45 withheld units, with exact trial/unit identities and time grid.

data_manifest.prepared_split_warning: Train/test NWBs and MC_Maze Large/Medium/Small variants are derived releases of a source acquisition, not independent datasets.

recording_contract.neural: Actual NWB header confirms units/spike_times with ragged spike_times_index, heldout-unit flags and observation intervals;182units in the inspected training file. Unit labels are not persistent identities across other sessions.
recording_contract.labels: Actual training NWB contains2295trial-table rows and columns active_target, barrier_pos, barrier_pos_index, delay, go_cue_time, id, maze_id, move_onset_time, num_barriers, num_targets, rt, split, start_time, stop_time, success, target_on_time, target_pos, target_pos_index, trial_type, trial_version. Hand position/velocity are timestamped behavioral arrays. Additional labels must be masked when they are prediction targets.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Sorted spike timestamps and trial/event times are aligned in the NWB time base. Official NWBDataset bins spikes on a1ms grid and resamples for5ms/20ms benchmarks; MC_Maze behavior uses timestamps, Area2 uses starting_time/rate. Rate values and unit conversion still need acquisition qualification.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: One Jenkins session; group whole reach trials/maze conditions; use official unit masks; no between-animal generalization.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

reference.role: Official Neural Latents Benchmark organizer code for loading, masking, evaluation and supplied baselines on these prepared recordings; distinguish this from the original Churchland/Chowdhury acquisition analysis code.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Poisson co-smoothing bits per spike, normalized by each withheld neuron's evaluation-target mean on the fixed support. The local scorer requires finite strictly positive expected counts; this differs from official zero-clipping edge-case handling. The training-only condition/time predictor is a separate signed comparator.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
